ModMetaData.description: Read-only deep diagnostics for repeated Wait and unexpected drafted-command authority. Records draft transitions, direct field drift, job lifecycle, player-forced queues, DCP authority gates and Harmony owners. Automatically writes a bounded report when suspicious waits appear. It does not change pawns, jobs, queues or gameplay results.
